verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נִקְרָ֛א בְּסֵ֥פֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְנִמְצָא֙ כָּת֣וּב בּ֔וֹ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־ יָב֨וֹא עַמֹּנִ֧י וּמֹאָבִ֛י בִּקְהַ֥ל הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū niq·rā bə·sê·p̄er mō·šeh bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·‘ām wə·nim·ṣā kā·ṯūḇ bōw ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḇō·w ‘am·mō·nî ū·mō·’ā·ḇî biq·hal hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: At that time the Book of Moses was read aloud in the hearing of the people and in it they found the passage stating that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever . . . enter the assembly of God
verses.literalPt: NAQUELE dia leu-se no livro de Moisés, aos ouvidos do povo; e achou-se escrito nele que os amonitas e os moabitas não entrassem jamais na congregação de Deus,

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א קִדְּמ֛וּ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּלֶּ֣חֶם וּבַמָּ֑יִם וַיִּשְׂכֹּ֨ר עָלָ֤יו אֶת־ בִּלְעָם֙ לְקַֽלְל֔וֹ וַיַּהֲפֹ֧ךְ אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ הַקְּלָלָ֖ה לִבְרָכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō qid·də·mū ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bal·le·ḥem ū·ḇam·mā·yim way·yiś·kōr ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- bil·‘ām lə·qal·lōw way·ya·hă·p̄ōḵ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū haq·qə·lā·lāh liḇ·rā·ḵāh
verses.literal: because they had not met the Israelites . . . with food and water but had hired Balaam to call down a curse against them although our God had turned the curse into a blessing
verses.literalPt: Porquanto não tinham saído ao encontro dos filhos de Israel com pão e água; antes contra eles assalariaram a Balaão para os amaldiçoar; porém o nosso Deus converteu a maldição em bênção.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י כְּשָׁמְעָ֣ם אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיַּבְדִּ֥ילוּ כָל־ עֵ֖רֶב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·šā·mə·‘ām ’eṯ- hat·tō·w·rāh way·yaḇ·dî·lū ḵāl ‘ê·reḇ mî·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As soon as the people heard this law they excluded from Israel all of foreign descent
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, pois, que, ouvindo eles esta lei, apartaram de Israel todo o elemento misto.

verses.original: וְלִפְנֵ֣י מִזֶּ֔ה אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן נָת֖וּן בְּלִשְׁכַּ֣ת בֵּית־ אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ קָר֖וֹב לְטוֹבִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lip̄·nê miz·zeh ’el·yā·šîḇ hak·kō·hên nā·ṯūn bə·liš·kaṯ bêṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū qā·rō·wḇ lə·ṭō·w·ḇî·yāh
verses.literal: Now before this Eliashib the priest a relative of Tobiah had been put in charge of the storerooms of the house of our God
verses.literalPt: Ora, antes disto, Eliasibe, sacerdote, que presidia sobre a câmara da casa do nosso Deus, se tinha aparentado com Tobias;

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ ל֜וֹ לִשְׁכָּ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֗ה וְשָׁ֣ם הָי֪וּ לְפָנִ֟ים נֹ֠תְנִים אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֨ה הַלְּבוֹנָ֜ה וְהַכֵּלִ֗ים וּמַעְשַׂ֤ר הַדָּגָן֙ הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֔ר מִצְוַת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים וּתְרוּמַ֖ת הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lōw liš·kāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh wə·šām hā·yū lə·p̄ā·nîm nō·ṯə·nîm ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh hal·lə·ḇō·w·nāh wə·hak·kê·lîm ū·ma‘·śar had·dā·ḡān hat·tî·rō·wōš wə·hay·yiṣ·hār miṣ·waṯ hal·wî·yim wə·ham·šō·rə·rîm wə·haš·šō·‘ă·rîm ū·ṯə·rū·maṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm
verses.literal: and had prepared for Tobiah a large room where . . . they had previously stored the grain offerings the frankincense the temple articles and the tithes of grain new wine and oil prescribed for the Levites singers and gatekeepers along with the contributions for the priests
verses.literalPt: E fizera-lhe uma câmara grande, onde dantes se depositavam as ofertas de alimentos, o incenso, os utensílios, os dízimos do grão, do mosto e do azeite, que se ordenaram para os levitas, cantores e porteiros, como também a oferta alçada para os sacerdotes.

verses.original: וּבְכָל־ זֶ֕ה לֹ֥א הָיִ֖יתִי בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֡י בִּשְׁנַת֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וּשְׁתַּ֜יִם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֤סְתְּא מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ בָּ֣אתִי אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּלְקֵ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים נִשְׁאַ֥לְתִּי מִן־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḵāl zeh lō hā·yî·ṯî bî·rū·šā·lim kî biš·naṯ šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·ta·yim lə·’ar·taḥ·šast me·leḵ- bā·ḇel bā·ṯî ’el- ham·me·leḵ ū·lə·qêṣ yā·mîm niš·’al·tî min- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: While all this was happening I was not in Jerusalem because I had returned to Artaxerxes king of Babylon in the thirty-second . . . year of his reign Some time later . . . I obtained leave from the king
verses.literalPt: Mas durante tudo isto não estava eu em Jerusalém, porque no ano trinta e dois de Artaxerxes, rei de Babilônia, fui ter com o rei; mas após alguns dias tornei a alcançar licença do rei.

verses.original: וָאָב֖וֹא לִֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וָאָבִ֣ינָה בָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ לְט֣וֹבִיָּ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לוֹ֙ נִשְׁכָּ֔ה בְּחַצְרֵ֖י בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·ḇō·w lî·rū·šā·lim wā·’ā·ḇî·nāh ḇā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’el·yā·šîḇ lə·ṭō·w·ḇî·yāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lōw niš·kāh bə·ḥaṣ·rê bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: to return to Jerusalem Then I discovered the evil that Eliashib had done on behalf of Tobiah by providing him a room in the courts of the house of God
verses.literalPt: E voltando a Jerusalém, compreendi o mal que Eliasibe fizera para Tobias, fazendo-lhe uma câmara nos pátios da casa de Deus.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥רַֽע לִ֖י מְאֹ֑ד וָֽאַשְׁלִ֜יכָה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֧י בֵית־ טוֹבִיָּ֛ה הַח֖וּץ מִן־ הַלִּשְׁכָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ra‘ lî mə·’ōḏ wā·’aš·lî·ḵāh ’eṯ- kāl- kə·lê ḇêṯ- ṭō·w·ḇî·yāh ha·ḥūṣ min- hal·liš·kāh
verses.literal: And I was greatly displeased and threw all of Tobiah’s household goods out of the room
verses.literalPt: O que muito me desagradou; de sorte que lancei todos os móveis da casa de Tobias fora da câmara.

verses.original: וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה וַֽיְטַהֲר֖וּ הַלְּשָׁכ֑וֹת וָאָשִׁ֣יבָה שָּׁ֗ם כְּלֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֖ה וְהַלְּבוֹנָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mə·rāh way·ṭa·hă·rū hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ wā·’ā·šî·ḇāh šām kə·lê bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh wə·hal·lə·ḇō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Then I ordered that the rooms be purified and I had the articles of the house of God restored to them along with the grain offerings and frankincense
verses.literalPt: E, ordenando-o eu, purificaram as câmaras; e tornei a trazer para ali os utensílios da casa de Deus, com as ofertas de alimentos e o incenso.

verses.original: וָאֵ֣דְעָ֔ה כִּֽי־ מְנָי֥וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לֹ֣א נִתָּ֑נָה וַיִּבְרְח֧וּ אִישׁ־ לְשָׂדֵ֛הוּ הַלְוִיִּ֥ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים עֹשֵׂ֥י הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·ḏə·‘āh kî- mə·nā·yō·wṯ hal·wî·yim lō nit·tā·nāh way·yiḇ·rə·ḥū ’îš- lə·śā·ḏê·hū hal·wî·yim wə·ham·šō·rə·rîm ‘ō·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: I also learned that because the portions for the Levites had not been given to them all the Levites and singers responsible for performing the service had gone back to their own fields
verses.literalPt: Também entendi que os quinhões dos levitas não se lhes davam, de maneira que os levitas e os cantores, que faziam a obra, tinham fugido cada um para a sua terra.

verses.original: וָאָרִ֙יבָה֙ אֶת־ הַסְּגָנִ֔ים וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה מַדּ֖וּעַ נֶעֱזַ֣ב בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וָֽאֶ֨קְבְּצֵ֔ם וָֽאַעֲמִדֵ֖ם עַל־ עָמְדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·rî·ḇāh ’eṯ- has·sə·ḡā·nîm wā·’ō·mə·rāh mad·dū·a‘ ne·‘ĕ·zaḇ bêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wā·’eq·bə·ṣêm wā·’a·‘ă·mi·ḏêm ‘al- ‘ā·mə·ḏām
verses.literal: So I rebuked the officials and asked Why has the house of God been neglected Then I gathered the Levites and singers together and stationed them at their posts
verses.literalPt: Então contendi com os magistrados, e disse: Por que se desamparou a casa de Deus? Porém eu os ajuntei, e os restaurei no seu posto.

verses.original: וְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֗ה הֵבִ֜יאוּ מַעְשַׂ֧ר הַדָּגָ֛ן וְהַתִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֖ר לָאוֹצָרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh hê·ḇî·’ū ma‘·śar had·dā·ḡān wə·hat·tî·rō·wōš wə·hay·yiṣ·hār lā·’ō·w·ṣā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: and all Judah brought a tenth of the grain new wine and oil into the storerooms
verses.literalPt: Então todo o Judá trouxe os dízimos do grão, do mosto e do azeite aos celeiros.

verses.original: וָאוֹצְרָ֣ה עַל־ א֠וֹצָרוֹת שֶׁלֶמְיָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְצָד֣וֹק הַסּוֹפֵ֗ר וּפְדָיָה֙ מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְעַל־ יָדָ֔ם חָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־ מַתַּנְיָ֑ה כִּ֤י נֶאֱמָנִים֙ נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לַחֲלֹ֥ק לַאֲחֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·wṣ·rāh ‘al- ’ō·w·ṣā·rō·wṯ še·lem·yāh hak·kō·hên wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq has·sō·w·p̄êr ū·p̄ə·ḏā·yāh min- hal·wî·yim wə·‘al- yā·ḏām ḥā·nān ben- zak·kūr ben- mat·tan·yāh kî ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm neḥ·šā·ḇū wa·‘ă·lê·hem la·ḥă·lōq la·’ă·ḥê·hem
verses.literal: I appointed as treasurers over the storerooms Shelemiah the priest Zadok the scribe and Pedaiah of the Levites with Hanan son of Zaccur the son of Mattaniah to assist them because they were considered trustworthy They were responsible for distributing the supplies to their fellow Levites
verses.literalPt: E por tesoureiros pus sobre os celeiros a Selemias, o sacerdote, e a Zadoque, o escrivão e a Pedaías, dentre os levitas; e com eles Hanã, filho de Zacur, o filho de Matanias; porque foram achados fiéis; e se lhes encarregou a eles a distribuição para seus irmãos.

verses.original: זָכְרָה־ לִּ֥י אֱלֹהַ֖י עַל־ זֹ֑את וְאַל־ תֶּ֣מַח חֲסָדַ֗י אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהַ֖י וּבְמִשְׁמָרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵə·rāh- lî ’ĕ·lō·hay ‘al- zōṯ wə·’al- te·maḥ ḥă·sā·ḏay ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hay ū·ḇə·miš·mā·rāw
verses.literal: Remember me for this O my God and do not blot out my deeds of loving devotion - for the house of my God and for its services
verses.literalPt: Por isto, Deus meu, lembra-te de mim e não risques as beneficências que eu fiz à casa de meu Deus e às suas observâncias.

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֡מָּה רָאִ֣יתִי בִֽיהוּדָ֣ה׀ דֹּֽרְכִֽים־ גִּתּ֣וֹת׀ בַּשַּׁבָּ֡ת וּמְבִיאִ֣ים הָעֲרֵמ֣וֹת וְֽעֹמְסִ֪ים עַל־ הַחֲמֹרִ֟ים וְאַף־ יַ֜יִן עֲנָבִ֤ים וּתְאֵנִים֙ וְכָל־ מַשָּׂ֔א וּמְבִיאִ֥ים יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וָאָעִ֕יד בְּי֖וֹם מִכְרָ֥ם צָֽיִד׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm·māh rā·’î·ṯî ḇî·hū·ḏāh dō·rə·ḵîm- git·tō·wṯ baš·šab·bāṯ ū·mə·ḇî·’îm hā·‘ă·rê·mō·wṯ wə·‘ō·mə·sîm ‘al- ha·ḥă·mō·rîm wə·’ap̄- ya·yin ‘ă·nā·ḇîm ū·ṯə·’ê·nîm wə·ḵāl maś·śā ū·mə·ḇî·’îm yə·rū·šā·lim bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ wā·’ā·‘îḏ bə·yō·wm miḵ·rām ṣā·yiḏ
verses.literal: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys along with wine grapes and figs All kinds of goods were being brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day So I warned them against selling food on that day
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias vi em Judá os que pisavam lagares ao sábado e traziam feixes que carregavam sobre os jumentos; como também vinho, uvas e figos, e toda a espécie de cargas, que traziam a Jerusalém no dia de sábado; e protestei contra eles no dia em que vendiam mantimentos.

verses.original: וְהַצֹּרִים֙ יָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ מְבִיאִ֥ים דָּ֖אג וְכָל־ מֶ֑כֶר וּמֹכְרִ֧ים בַּשַּׁבָּ֛ת לִבְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṣ·ṣō·rîm yā·šə·ḇū ḇāh mə·ḇî·’îm dāḡ wə·ḵāl me·ḵer ū·mō·ḵə·rîm baš·šab·bāṯ liḇ·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Additionally, men of Tyre who lived there were importing fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling them on the Sabbath to the people of Judah in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Também habitavam em Jerusalém tírios que traziam peixe e toda a mercadoria, que vendiam no sábado aos filhos de Judá, e em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וָאָרִ֕יבָה אֵ֖ת חֹרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וָאֹמְרָ֣ה לָהֶ֗ם מָֽה־ הַדָּבָ֨ר הָרָ֤ע הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים וּֽמְחַלְּלִ֖ים אֶת־ י֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·rî·ḇāh ’êṯ ḥō·rê yə·hū·ḏāh wā·’ō·mə·rāh lā·hem māh- had·dā·ḇār hā·rā‘ haz·zeh ’ă·šer ’at·tem ‘ō·śîm ū·mə·ḥal·lə·lîm ’eṯ- yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ
verses.literal: Then I rebuked . . . the nobles of Judah and asked What . . . is this evil you are doing profaning the Sabbath day
verses.literalPt: E contendi com os nobres de Judá, e lhes disse: Que mal é este que fazeis, profanando o dia de sábado?

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא כֹ֤ה עָשׂוּ֙ אֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וַיָּבֵ֨א אֱלֹהֵ֜ינוּ עָלֵ֗ינוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וְעַ֖ל הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וְאַתֶּ֞ם מוֹסִיפִ֤ים חָרוֹן֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְחַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־ הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ḵōh ‘ā·śū ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem way·yā·ḇê ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘ā·lê·nū ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ wə·‘al hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·’at·tem mō·w·sî·p̄îm ḥā·rō·wn ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḥal·lêl ’eṯ- haš·šab·bāṯ
verses.literal: Did not your forefathers do the same things so that our God brought all this disaster on us and on this city And now you are rekindling His wrath against Israel by profaning the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Porventura não fizeram vossos pais assim, e não trouxe o nosso Deus todo este mal sobre nós e sobre esta cidade? E vós ainda mais acrescentais o ardor de sua ira sobre Israel, profanando o sábado.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צָֽלֲלוּ֩ שַׁעֲרֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לִפְנֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת וָאֹֽמְרָה֙ וַיִּסָּגְר֣וּ הַדְּלָת֔וֹת וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִפְתָּח֔וּם עַ֖ד אַחַ֣ר הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וּמִנְּעָרַ֗י הֶֽעֱמַ֙דְתִּי֙ עַל־ הַשְּׁעָרִ֔ים לֹא־ יָב֥וֹא מַשָּׂ֖א בְּי֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer ṣā·lă·lū ša·‘ă·rê yə·rū·šā·lim lip̄·nê haš·šab·bāṯ wā·’ō·mə·rāh way·yis·sā·ḡə·rū had·də·lā·ṯō·wṯ wā·’ō·mə·rāh ’ă·šer lō yip̄·tā·ḥūm ‘aḏ ’a·ḥar haš·šab·bāṯ ū·min·nə·‘ā·ray he·‘ĕ·maḏ·tî ‘al- haš·šə·‘ā·rîm lō- yā·ḇō·w maś·śā bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ
verses.literal: When the evening shadows began to fall on the gates of Jerusalem just before the Sabbath I ordered that the gates . . . be shut and not opened until after the Sabbath I posted some of my servants at the gates so that no load could enter on the Sabbath day
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, pois, que, dando já sombra nas portas de Jerusalém antes do sábado, ordenei que as portas fossem fechadas; e mandei que não as abrissem até passado o sábado; e pus às portas alguns de meus servos, para que nenhuma carga entrasse no dia de sábado.

verses.original: וַיָּלִ֨ינוּ הָרֹכְלִ֜ים וּמֹכְרֵ֧י כָל־ מִמְכָּ֛ר מִח֥וּץ לִירוּשָׁלִָ֖ם פַּ֥עַם וּשְׁתָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·lî·nū hā·rō·ḵə·lîm ū·mō·ḵə·rê ḵāl mim·kār mi·ḥūṣ lî·rū·šā·lim pa·‘am ū·šə·tā·yim
verses.literal: Once or twice the merchants and those who sell all kinds of goods camped outside Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Então os negociantes e os vendedores de toda a mercadoria passaram a noite fora de Jerusalém, uma ou duas vezes.

verses.original: וָאָעִ֣ידָה בָהֶ֗ם וָאֹמְרָ֤ה אֲלֵיהֶם֙ מַדּ֜וּעַ אַתֶּ֤ם לֵנִים֙ נֶ֣גֶד הַחוֹמָ֔ה אִם־ תִּשְׁנ֕וּ יָ֖ד אֶשְׁלַ֣ח בָּכֶ֑ם מִן־ הָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא לֹא־ בָ֖אוּ בַּשַּׁבָּֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·‘î·ḏāh ḇā·hem wā·’ō·mə·rāh ’ă·lê·hem mad·dū·a‘ ’at·tem lê·nîm ne·ḡeḏ ha·ḥō·w·māh ’im- tiš·nū yāḏ ’eš·laḥ bā·ḵem min- hā·‘êṯ ha·hî lō- ḇā·’ū baš·šab·bāṯ
verses.literal: but I warned them - Why are you camping in front of the wall If you do it again I will lay hands on you From that time on they did not return on the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Protestei, pois, contra eles, e lhes disse: Por que passais a noite defronte do muro? Se outra vez o fizerdes, hei de lançar mão de vós. Daquele tempo em diante não vieram no sábado.

verses.original: וָאֹמְרָ֣ה לַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽהְי֤וּ מִֽטַּהֲרִים֙ וּבָאִים֙ שֹׁמְרִ֣ים הַשְּׁעָרִ֔ים לְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־ י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת גַּם־ זֹאת֙ זָכְרָה־ לִּ֣י אֱלֹהַ֔י וְח֥וּסָה עָלַ֖י כְּרֹ֥ב חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mə·rāh lal·wî·yim ’ă·šer yih·yū miṭ·ṭa·hă·rîm ū·ḇā·’îm šō·mə·rîm haš·šə·‘ā·rîm lə·qad·dêš ’eṯ- yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ gam- zōṯ zā·ḵə·rāh- lî ’ĕ·lō·hay wə·ḥū·sāh ‘ā·lay kə·rōḇ ḥas·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Then I instructed the Levites - to purify themselves . . . and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy Remember me for this as well O my God and show me mercy according to Your abundant loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Também disse aos levitas que se purificassem, e viessem guardar as portas, para santificar o sábado. Nisto também, Deus meu, lembra-te de mim e perdoa-me segundo a abundância da tua benignidade.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם׀ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֗ם רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת־ הַיְּהוּדִים֙ הֹשִׁ֗יבוּ נָשִׁים֙ אַשְׁדּוֹדִיּוֹת עַמּוֹנִיּוֹת מוֹאֲבִיּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: gam bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- hay·yə·hū·ḏîm hō·šî·ḇū nā·šîm ʾaš·dō·ḏī·yōṯ ʿam·mō·nī·yōṯ mō·w·’ă·ḇî·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: In those days I also saw Jews who had married women from Ashdod Ammon and Moab
verses.literalPt: Vi também naqueles dias judeus que tinham casado com mulheres asdoditas, amonitas e moabitas.

verses.original: וּבְנֵיהֶ֗ם חֲצִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אַשְׁדּוֹדִ֔ית וְאֵינָ֥ם מַכִּירִ֖ים לְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוּדִ֑ית וְכִלְשׁ֖וֹן עַ֥ם וָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê·hem ḥă·ṣî mə·ḏab·bêr ’aš·dō·w·ḏîṯ wə·’ê·nām mak·kî·rîm lə·ḏab·bêr yə·hū·ḏîṯ wə·ḵil·šō·wn ‘am wā·‘ām
verses.literal: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or of the other peoples . . . but could not speak the language of Judah
verses.literalPt: E seus filhos falavam meio asdodita, e não podiam falar judaico, senão segundo a língua de cada povo.

verses.original: וָאָרִ֤יב עִמָּם֙ וָאֲקַֽלְלֵ֔ם וָאַכֶּ֥ה מֵהֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וָֽאֶמְרְטֵ֑ם וָאַשְׁבִּיעֵ֣ם בֵּֽאלֹהִ֗ים אִם־ תִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ לִבְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְאִם־ תִּשְׂאוּ֙ מִבְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֖ם וְלָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·rîḇ ‘im·mām wā·’ă·qal·lêm wā·’ak·keh mê·hem ’ă·nā·šîm wā·’em·rə·ṭêm wā·’aš·bî·‘êm bê·lō·hîm ’im- tit·tə·nū ḇə·nō·ṯê·ḵem liḇ·nê·hem wə·’im- tiś·’ū mib·bə·nō·ṯê·hem liḇ·nê·ḵem wə·lā·ḵem
verses.literal: I rebuked them . . . and called down curses on them I beat some of these men and pulled out their hair Then I made them take an oath before God and said You must not give your daughters in marriage to their sons . . . or take their daughters as wives for your sons or for yourselves
verses.literalPt: E contendi com eles, e os amaldiçoei e espanquei alguns deles, e lhes arranquei os cabelos, e os fiz jurar por Deus, dizendo: Não dareis mais vossas filhas a seus filhos, e não tomareis mais suas filhas, nem para vossos filhos nem para vós mesmos.

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא עַל־ אֵ֣לֶּה חָטָֽא־ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וּבַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָרַבִּים֩ לֹֽא־ הָיָ֨ה מֶ֜לֶךְ כָּמֹ֗הוּ וְאָה֤וּב לֵֽאלֹהָיו֙ הָיָ֔ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֣הוּ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גַּם־ אוֹת֣וֹ הֶחֱטִ֔יאוּ הַנָּשִׁ֖ים הַנָּכְרִיּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ‘al- ’êl·leh ḥā·ṭā- šə·lō·mōh me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇag·gō·w·yim hā·rab·bîm lō- hā·yāh me·leḵ kā·mō·hū wə·’ā·hūḇ lê·lō·hāw hā·yāh way·yit·tə·nê·hū ’ĕ·lō·hîm me·leḵ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl gam- ’ō·w·ṯōw he·ḥĕ·ṭî·’ū han·nā·šîm han·nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: Did not King Solomon of Israel sin in matters like this There was not a king like him among many nations and he was loved by his God who made him king over all Israel yet foreign women drew him into sin
verses.literalPt: Porventura não pecou nisto Salomão, rei de Israel, não havendo entre muitas nações rei semelhante a ele, e sendo ele amado de seu Deus, e pondo-o Deus rei sobre todo o Israel? E contudo as mulheres estrangeiras o fizeram pecar.

verses.original: וְלָכֶ֣ם הֲנִשְׁמַ֗ע לַעֲשֹׂת֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את לִמְעֹ֖ל בֵּֽאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְהֹשִׁ֖יב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·ḵem hă·niš·ma‘ la·‘ă·śōṯ ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh haz·zōṯ lim·‘ōl bê·lō·hê·nū lə·hō·šîḇ nā·šîm nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: Must we now hear that you too are doing all this terrible evil and acting unfaithfully against our God by marrying foreign women
verses.literalPt: E dar-vos-íamos nós ouvidos, para fazermos todo este grande mal, prevaricando contra o nosso Deus, casando com mulheres estrangeiras?

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֨י יוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן־ אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל חָתָ֖ן לְסַנְבַלַּ֣ט הַחֹרֹנִ֑י וָאַבְרִיחֵ֖הוּ מֵעָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê yō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ben- ’el·yā·šîḇ hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl ḥā·ṯān lə·san·ḇal·laṭ ha·ḥō·rō·nî wā·’aḇ·rî·ḥê·hū mê·‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: Even one of the sons of Jehoiada son of Eliashib the high priest had become a son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite Therefore I drove him away from me
verses.literalPt: Também um dos filhos de Joiada, filho de Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, era genro de Sambalate, o horonita, por isso o afugentei de mim.

verses.original: זָכְרָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם אֱלֹהָ֑י עַ֚ל גָּאֳלֵ֣י הַכְּהֻנָּ֔ה וּבְרִ֥ית הַכְּהֻנָּ֖ה וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵə·rāh lā·hem ’ĕ·lō·hāy ‘al gā·’o·lê hak·kə·hun·nāh ū·ḇə·rîṯ hak·kə·hun·nāh wə·hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: Remember them O my God because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites
verses.literalPt: Lembra-te deles, Deus meu, pois contaminaram o sacerdócio, como também a aliança do sacerdócio e dos levitas.

verses.original: וְטִֽהַרְתִּ֖ים מִכָּל־ נֵכָ֑ר וָאַעֲמִ֧ידָה מִשְׁמָר֛וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ בִּמְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭi·har·tîm mik·kāl nê·ḵār wā·’a·‘ă·mî·ḏāh miš·mā·rō·wṯ lak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lal·wî·yim ’îš bim·laḵ·tōw
verses.literal: Thus I purified the priests and Levites from everything foreign and I assigned specific duties to each of the priests and Levites
verses.literalPt: Assim os limpei de todo o estrangeiro, e designei os cargos dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, cada um na sua obra.

verses.original: וּלְקֻרְבַּ֧ן הָעֵצִ֛ים בְּעִתִּ֥ים מְזֻמָּנ֖וֹת וְלַבִּכּוּרִ֑ים זָכְרָה־ לִּ֥י אֱלֹהַ֖י לְטוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·qur·ban hā·‘ê·ṣîm bə·‘it·tîm mə·zum·mā·nō·wṯ wə·lab·bik·kū·rîm zā·ḵə·rāh- lî ’ĕ·lō·hay lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: I also arranged for contributions of wood at the appointed times and for the firstfruits Remember me O my God with favor
verses.literalPt: Como também para com as ofertas de lenha em tempos determinados, e para com as primícias; lembra-te de mim, Deus meu, para bem.
